# Repo-owned CLI11 snapshot

This source is a snapshot of [CLIUtils/CLI11](https://github.com/CLIUtils/CLI11) at commit `95324820650117a2668ed63b095007068fd0c475`, the exact gitlink previously recorded by Enroth Continuum. On 2026-11-07, all 187 original tracked files were copied from a clean local checkout at that commit and verified against its Git blob IDs without source edits.

The original BSD-style `LICENSE` is retained. This provenance note is Enroth Continuum metadata, not part of the original snapshot. The Mac build consumes this directory through `thirdparty/CMakeLists.txt`; its optional test/example FetchContent paths are not enabled for the app build. Other dependencies remain external until migrated separately.
